import numpy as np

# --- Setup / quaternions ---
# Hammer lies along Y (handle +Y, head -Y). Both grippers face down and open along X
# so the fingers close across the handle. Arm0 grasps near the handle end (+Y side),
# Arm1 grasps the handle on the head side (-Y of center), keeping ~9.5cm between grippers.
q0_down_openX = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # Arm0 facing down, opening along X
q1_down_openX = np.array([0.0, 0.707, -0.707, 0.0])  # Arm1 facing down, opening along X

ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y = 0.05    # Arm0 grasp offset from handle center toward handle end (+Y)
ARM1_GRASP_OFF_Y = -0.045  # Arm1 grasp offset from handle center toward head (-Y), still on handle
HANDOVER_X = 0.81          # midpoint between arm initial x positions (0.44 and 1.18)
HANDOVER_Z = 0.175         # hammer z during handover (within 0.15 - 0.20)
HIGH_Z = 0.32              # safe travel height

# --- Step 1: Arm0 picks up hammer ---
hammer_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
grasp0 = hammer_pos.copy()
grasp0[1] += ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y
grasp0[2] += 0.005

open_gripper_arm0()
# Move above the grasp point first (pure translation at safe height), then descend
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([grasp0[0], grasp0[1], grasp0[2] + 0.15]), q0_down_openX)
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, q0_down_openX, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper_arm0()

# --- Step 2: Lift and carry to handover location ---
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([grasp0[0], grasp0[1], HIGH_Z]), q0_down_openX)
# Translate at safe height to above the handover point (keep hammer center at y=0)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, 0.0 + ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y, HIGH_Z]), q0_down_openX)
# Lower to handover height
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, 0.0 + ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y, HANDOVER_Z]), q0_down_openX)

# --- Step 3: Arm1 grasps handle (head side of center, away from Arm0's gripper) ---
cur_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
grasp1 = cur_pos.copy()
grasp1[1] += ARM1_GRASP_OFF_Y

open_gripper_arm1()
# Approach from above, pure vertical descent onto the handle
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([grasp1[0], grasp1[1], grasp1[2] + 0.15]), q1_down_openX)
goto_pose_arm1(grasp1, q1_down_openX, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Step 4: Arm0 releases and retreats ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, 0.0 + ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y, HIGH_Z]), q0_down_openX)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.5, 0.0 + ARM0_GRASP_OFF_Y, HIGH_Z]), q0_down_openX)
